native_schema.name: context7_get_cached_doc_raw
native_schema.description: Read this plugin's validated Context7 docs cache by exact doc_ref, or deterministically match at most 500 ordered records by query with an optional exact library_id filter. It performs no network request and never exposes storage paths, endpoints, credentials, raw errors, or unparsed bodies.

doc_ref.description: Exact opaque ctx7d_ reference returned by a Context7 docs tool.

query.description: Non-empty deterministic cache-match query used only when doc_ref is absent.

library_id.description: Optional exact Context7 id used only as a cache-record filter.

native_schema.name: context7_get_library_docs
native_schema.description: Resolve a library name when needed, then query Context7 through the same persistent TTL cache and Provider client. An exact library_id strictly skips resolve. raw is a validated cache envelope; all results are discovery evidence.

library_name.description: Package or product name to resolve when library_id is absent.

library_id.description: Exact Context7 id. When supplied, resolve is skipped even if library_name is also present.

max_results.description: Maximum resolve candidates from 1 through 20; defaults to 8.

max_snippets.description: Maximum snippets from 1 through 20; defaults to 8.

raw.description: Return the validated bounded cache envelope instead of the ordinary snippet projection.

force_refresh.description: Bypass fresh Context7 resolve/docs cache entries.

native_schema.name: context7_query_docs
native_schema.description: Query documentation for an exact Context7 /org/project[/version] id. raw=false returns structured snippets; raw=true returns only a validated bounded cache envelope, never a Provider body, path, endpoint, or credential. Discovery only; verify claims with web_extract.

max_snippets.description: Maximum snippets from 1 through 20; defaults to 5.

raw.description: Return the validated bounded cache envelope, never an unparsed Provider body or backend file.

force_refresh.description: Bypass a fresh docs cache entry; expired transient failures may still use stale cache.

native_schema.name: context7_resolve_library_id
native_schema.description: Resolve a package/product name to an exact Context7 library id. Skip this tool when /org/project[/version] is already known. Returns bounded safe candidates and cache/Provider facts; discovery only.

library_name.description: Non-empty package or product name. If an exact /org/project[/version] id is already known, call context7_query_docs instead.

query.description: Optional non-empty task context used only to rank the bounded candidates.

max_results.description: Maximum candidates from 1 through 20; defaults to 8.

force_refresh.description: Bypass a fresh resolve cache entry; expired transient failures may still use stale cache.

native_schema.name: docs_search
native_schema.description: High-level SDK/API/framework/README/release documentation search. Routes Context7 first and optionally Exa, returns discovery snippets and durable source_ref pagination; common documentation tasks do not need granular Context7 tools.

query.description: A non-empty SDK, API, framework, README, release, or documentation question.

provider.description: auto (default), Context7, Exa, or both documentation discovery routes.

library_id.description: Optional exact Context7 /org/project or /org/project/version id; valid ids skip resolve.

max_results.description: Maximum results (1-20); defaults to 6 and may be lowered by Settings.

force_refresh.description: Bypass fresh Context7 cache entries and request current Provider data.

native_schema.name: research_plan
native_schema.description: Generate one offline research plan only for explicit deep research, multi-source verification, or complex comparison. It does not search, fetch, or verify claims; execute only the listed stable plugin tools and fetch key pages with web_extract before claim-level conclusions.

question.description: Non-empty research question to plan without searching or fetching.

budget.description: Bounded planning breadth/depth intent; defaults to standard.

known_urls.description: At most 10 known source URLs; a lower deployment cap may apply.

items.description: Absolute HTTP(S) source URL without userinfo.

sub_queries.description: One through 6 focused sub-questions when supplied.

id.description: Stable caller-owned sub-question id such as sq1.

tool.description: Optional explicit plugin tool; deferred tools must be disclosed before execution.

query.description: Optional bounded tool query or URL; defaults deterministically.

native_schema.name: search_diagnostics
native_schema.description: Read-only masked search capability/config status. show is network-free. Use test only when the user explicitly requests connection diagnostics; test runs bounded fixed Provider health probes. API keys are never parameters or output, config writes happen only through DSH Settings/UI, and ordinary searches should not call this tool.

action.description: Use show for network-free masked capability/config status. Use test only after the user explicitly requests bounded connection diagnostics.

native_schema.name: search_sources
native_schema.description: Page discovery sources retained by web_search or docs_search for the current Agent session or an inherited fork. The private search_enhance_sources storage must be backed up and restored together with the session.

source_ref.description: Opaque source reference returned by web_search or docs_search.

limit.description: Positive page size; defaults to 20 and is capped by Settings.

format.description: compact (default) or full with bounded snippets.

native_schema.name: search_tools
native_schema.description: Disclose one or more deferred search capability groups for the current Agent. Use only when the resident search tools cannot complete the task; do not activate every group preemptively. A successful call takes effect on the next model step and does not bypass restrictions from other Presets.

capabilities.description: One to five deferred search capability groups to disclose for this Agent.

native_schema.name: web_extract
native_schema.description: Read a specific HTTP(S) URL through independent extraction/direct routes. No JavaScript or login; host-reachable addresses may be accessed, and evidence differs by route.

url.description: A non-empty concrete HTTP(S) URL to read.

native_schema.name: web_map
native_schema.description: Discover a bounded set of links under a known HTTP(S) website. Results are discovery candidates, not fetched page-body evidence.

url.description: Absolute HTTP(S) root URL to map through Tavily; userinfo is rejected.

instructions.description: Optional natural-language filter for the website crawl.

max_breadth.description: Maximum links followed per level (1-500); defaults to 10 and must not exceed the deployment cap.

limit.description: Total links processed (1-500); defaults to 30 and must not exceed the deployment cap.
